clue.text: Friendly question of what I can do

definitions.text: question of what I can do
definitions.meaning: split up, the word reads as the question '...?', asking what one is capable of

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is read by splitting the word into three: AM I ABLE?
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a genial, likeable person is described as both friendly and good-natured.

clue.text: One may go to pot

parts.note: to go to pot is to deteriorate, but here pot is also cannabis, which a drug user goes to

explanation.surface: Someone or something that might fall into ruin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Go to pot' means decline, but 'pot' is slang for cannabis, the habit's object.
explanation.definitionFit: A cryptic description: a drug-dependent person turns to pot, the slang term for cannabis.

clue.text: Having nothing particular to do, I would fish

parts.note: I would contracts to I'd
the ling is a long fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: Someone at a loose end decides to go fishing.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: being unoccupied and passing time without purpose is what loafing about means.

clue.text: Bet it's the wife!

parts.note: the word 'Bet' is the second half of the six-letter word 'better'

explanation.surface: A confident guess that it is the wife on the phone or at the door.
explanation.walkthrough: BET is half of the letters of BETTER, so the clue's first word is literally a 'better half'.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a spouse, especially a wife, is affectionately called one's better half.

clue.text: Are no longer first

parts.note: ex- describes something former, no longer so
first is written 1st, with I standing in for the figure one

explanation.surface: Someone who has lost top place.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the single word 'Are', a verb meaning to be.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to be present or have being, as in 'there are'; both verbs state that something lives on.

clue.text: Cut by instrument, doctor is cross

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so these letters are falsified into a new order

explanation.surface: A doctor gets annoyed after being cut with a surgical instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doctor' looks like a noun but is a verb working on IS CROSS.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to cut with a bladed two-handled tool, an instrument.

clue.text: Number observed to hold race, perhaps

indicators.note: one word holding another means the second sits inside the first

parts.note: observed means seen
a race is one example of a sporting event, hence 'perhaps'

explanation.surface: A number was spotted at a race, perhaps a runner's bib.
explanation.definitionFit: The answer is a whole number, ten plus seven, so it is an example of a number.

clue.text: Something missing from Irish flag

indicators.note: one item absent from the word Irish means one of its letters, here its last, is dropped

explanation.surface: A missing feature of the Irish national flag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flag' is not a banner but a plant: the yellow flag is a wild iris.
explanation.definitionFit: Botanical sense: a flag is a plant of the iris family with sword-shaped leaves.

clue.text: A noted work of his remained unfinished

definitions.text: A noted work of his remained unfinished

parts.words: A noted work of his remained unfinished
parts.note: a composer whose famous Eighth Symphony is known as the Unfinished; 'noted' hints at musical notes

explanation.surface: A famous creator left one of his works incomplete.
explanation.walkthrough: 'noted' means both famous and written in musical notes.
explanation.definitionFit: The Austrian composer's Symphony No. 8 in B minor is nicknamed the Unfinished Symphony.

clue.text: Flier makes Marxist jump

parts.note: red is a common label for a communist
to start is to jump in surprise

explanation.surface: A pilot startles a communist.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the bird with a reddish tail is a flier, as all birds are.

clue.text: Currency comes in handy getting Dutch pottery

indicators.note: one piece coming in to another means it is placed inside it

parts.note: handy means skilful, deft
L stands for a currency, the pound or lira

explanation.surface: Cash proves useful when buying Dutch ceramics.
explanation.definitionFit: Tin-glazed blue-and-white earthenware named after the Dutch town where it was made.

clue.text: Launched attack but he'd give in, beaten

indicators.note: beaten letters are knocked about and into a fresh order

explanation.surface: He went on the offensive but gave up once defeated.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to rail or protest bitterly is to make a verbal assault on someone.

clue.text: One struggles to study before exam — exemplary worker

indicators.note: this piece is placed ahead of the next ones in the answer

parts.note: to con is an old word meaning to study or learn by heart
an exam is a test
the ant is proverbially industrious, the model worker

explanation.surface: A diligent student revises before an exam.
explanation.definitionFit: A competitor in a contest is someone who strives and battles to win.

clue.text: Give aid to a Yankee

parts.note: a Yankee is a type of bet: eleven wagers on four horses

explanation.surface: Helping an American.
explanation.walkthrough: A Yankee is a British bookmakers' term for a multiple bet of eleven wagers on four selections.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to assist or support someone, now usually in wrongdoing.

clue.text: Assume responsibility for fool employee

parts.note: to fool someone is to take them in, deceive them
a hand is a worker, as in farm hand

explanation.surface: A manager takes charge of a foolish worker.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to take control of a situation or person is to accept responsibility for them.

clue.text: One puts things right at last

definitions.text: One puts things right at last

parts.words: One puts things right at last
parts.note: a cobbler mends shoes on a last, the foot-shaped block they are shaped on

explanation.surface: Someone who finally sorts everything out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at last' seems to mean finally; a last is a cobbler's foot-shaped form.
explanation.definitionFit: A cobbler mends footwear, and does it on a last.

clue.text: Unhappy men she upset, spilling gin and getting engaged?

indicators.note: unhappy letters are disturbed and rearranged
upset letters are knocked over into another order
spilt letters are scattered and land in a new order

explanation.surface: Miserable men are upset by a woman who spills their gin and gets engaged.
explanation.walkthrough: MEN, SHE and GIN are rearranged together. 'getting engaged?' is cryptic: becoming entangled, as cogs or nets engage.
explanation.definitionFit: To be caught in a net or tangled up is a mechanical kind of engaging, hence the query.

clue.text: Some folk carelessly drop this character in the middle of nowhere

definitions.text: Some folk carelessly drop this character in the middle of nowhere

parts.words: Some folk carelessly drop this character in the middle of nowhere
parts.note: the letter H is the middle letter of 'nowhere' and is the breathy sound people drop when they drop their aitches

explanation.surface: Careless people leave someone stranded in a remote place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'character' is a letter: H, the centre of NOWHERE, which careless speakers drop.
explanation.definitionFit: Phonetics: the breathed sound of H is called by this name, and it is what speakers drop.

clue.text: Account with date once rendered

indicators.note: rendered means made into something else, so the letters are recast

explanation.surface: A bill bearing a date was once delivered.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a short amusing story about a real incident is an account of it.

clue.text: Wholly dedicated to remaining unmarried?

definitions.meaning: jokingly, minded to stay single, unwed

explanation.walkthrough: The second sense splits the word: having a mind to be single.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone with one purpose is resolutely focused; the second reading is whimsical.

clue.text: It needs to grow by more developing

indicators.note: developing letters change and grow into a new form

explanation.surface: Something must grow larger by developing more.
explanation.definitionFit: An unborn creature in its earliest stage still has all its growing ahead of it.

clue.text: Sorts out degrees

definitions.meaning: levels or steps on a scale

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for classifying by quality and a noun for levels of rank.

clue.text: Part of foot to move slowly

definitions.meaning: a twelfth of a foot as a length
to creep forward by small steps

explanation.walkthrough: 'foot' is the unit of length, not the body part.
explanation.definitionFit: The imperial unit is one twelfth of a foot; as a verb it means edge forward gradually.

clue.text: Night-watchman

parts.note: a security guard on night duty, but read literally a man who watches the night sky

explanation.walkthrough: A night-watchman is a guard, but read literally he watches the night sky through a telescope.
explanation.definitionFit: A scientist who studies stars and planets does most observing after dark.

clue.text: The US stock market depends on its products

definitions.text: The US stock market depends on its products

parts.words: The US stock market depends on its products
parts.note: the stock is livestock, not shares: cattle markets in the US depend on what big cattle farms produce

explanation.surface: Wall Street relies on what some company produces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stock market' suggests shares; here it is a livestock market supplied by cattle farms.
explanation.definitionFit: An American cattle-raising farm produces the beasts sold at livestock markets.

clue.text: Vehicle to move before take-off

definitions.meaning: an aircraft rolls along the runway before flying

explanation.definitionFit: The word names a hired cab and the verb for a plane trundling along the ground.

clue.text: Greatest respect for commercial delivery

parts.note: a commercial is an advertisement, an ad
an oration is a speech delivered formally

explanation.surface: Highest praise for an advertising pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: deep reverence or worship is the utmost esteem one can show.

clue.text: In modern times, consuming anger is publicly displayed

indicators.note: one word consuming another swallows it inside

parts.note: AD, Anno Domini, marks the years of the modern era
ire is anger

explanation.surface: Nowadays, rage is shown in public.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: views given an airing are broadcast or exposed to public view.

clue.text: Making uniform or sort of dress that's formal

definitions.meaning: the formal wear worn at night-time functions

explanation.walkthrough: 'uniform' means even, not clothing, despite the dress that follows.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb form of 'even' means levelling out, and formal wear for dinners is named after the time of day.

clue.text: Frightful house — I'd move

indicators.note: moving letters shifts them into a different order

explanation.surface: A dreadful home, so the speaker plans to relocate.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something extremely ugly or shocking is frightful to look at.
